nodes.description: The cell-level endpoint, and the step at which a molecular defect becomes a tissue one. In yeast the mutant allele induces cell death; in the fly ortholog the same loss depolarises mitochondria, drops ATP by 60 per cent and selectively cuts cytochrome c oxidase activity. The temperature dependence in yeast matters clinically: this is a conditional, dose-dependent collapse rather than an absolute one, which is what allows affected children to be born and to survive months rather than dying in utero.

nodes.description: The only in vivo animal work on this gene family that bears on the disease mechanism. Black-pearl is the Drosophila ortholog of MAGMAS/Pam16. Depleting it depolarises mitochondria, drops ATP by 60 per cent, raises reactive oxygen species 3.5-fold and selectively cuts cytochrome c oxidase activity by 65 per cent; in hypomorphic larvae, plasmatocyte number and mitochondrial staining fall and N-acetylcysteine doubles viability, which is the strongest evidence that ROS is a causal effector rather than a bystander. It is not a model of the disease: the allele is a knockdown or hypomorph rather than the human missense change, and flies have no endochondral skeleton.

nodes.description: The tissue lesion that produces the radiographic disease. Endochondral ossification converts a cartilage template into bone at the hypertrophic zone of the growth plate and the primary spongiosa immediately beneath it; these are precisely the two compartments in which MAGMAS is expressed, and the compartments above them, the resting and proliferative chondrocytes, are where it is not detected. Failure localised to the ossification front rather than to matrix production accounts for the pattern seen on radiographs: severe platyspondyly, delayed or absent epiphyseal ossification, metaphyseal widening and cupping, and abnormal modelling of the long bones, with the vertebral changes improving somewhat with age in the survivors.

nodes.description: The proximate biochemical failure. TIM23 imports around sixty per cent of the mitochondrial proteome, and matrix-destined precursors reach the matrix only because the PAM motor, of which MAGMAS is the J-like regulator, provides the inward pull. With the mutant allele the motor is too weak: precursor proteins that should be imported and proteolytically matured accumulate in their unprocessed form. Hsp60 is the reporter used to demonstrate this, but the defect is generic to the presequence pathway rather than specific to any one cargo.

nodes.description: The cardiac branch, and the one that killed the second family. Cardiac muscle is among the most mitochondria-dense tissues and is a recurring casualty of TIM23/PAM motor defects: mutations in DNAJC19, the direct J-protein partner of MAGMAS, cause dilated cardiomyopathy with ataxia. Both affected sibs in the second family developed severe cardiomegaly and died of heart failure at about 24 months. The branch is deliberately kept separate from the skeletal one because it did not occur in the first family despite the identical homozygous allele.

nodes.description: The initiating lesion. The recurrent Lebanese allele c.226A>G replaces asparagine 76 with aspartate in helix II of the C-terminal J-like domain of MAGMAS, the surface through which MAGMAS heterodimerises with the J-domain of DNAJC19. The substitution does not abolish the protein; it destabilises it, and the destabilised protein is present at reduced levels once the system is stressed. This is why the disease behaves as a hypomorph rather than as a null, and it is the molecular fact that the rest of the pathograph descends from.

nodes.description: The system in which the disease allele was functionally proven. Saccharomyces cerevisiae pam16-delta strains were rescued with a plasmid expressing either wild-type or p.Asn76Asp human MAGMAS. The mutant supported growth at 28 degrees but grew slowly at 34 and was inviable at 36 degrees, more severely on non-fermentable than on fermentable medium; at the non-permissive temperature it accumulated unprocessed Hsp60, expressed MAGMAS at reduced levels, showed a fragmented mitochondrial network and underwent pexophagy. The temperature sensitivity is the informative part: it demonstrates a conditional hypomorph rather than a null, which matches a disease compatible with live birth and months of survival.
